headline: German investor confidence rebounds to 35.6 points
summary: Germany's economic situation indicator for investor confidence improved from -35.9 to -33.2 points. The reading is the highest since April 2023.
why: Investor confidence surveys offer an early read on expectations for Europe's largest economy, which shapes European market sentiment.
original_headline: Confianza de inversionistas alemanes repunta hasta 35.6 pts
